notes:
### New

- Quests from Fontaine. She hired you, and she pays for what comes up from under the city: find her under Contacts on the dashboard. Her first quest is to go down into Rumors and get back out. Nine more follow, one at a time, and between them they tell why the Gloaming walks.
- A quest asks for things done below (a search, a kill, something made, a task in a room) and often something brought back. What's done below counts for everyone with you who has the quest, the moment it happens, even if you die after. Commit what she asks for from your stash on her page, then Report to her to be paid.
- Your open quests show at the left of your view below. Choose Track on the one you want to follow.
- Contacts, where People was: a portrait for each contact, then their page with Quests, Research and Store. Each quest you report adds a page to Fontaine's Research, and some teach you a recipe the Library won't.
- Room tasks: a bell to ring, a winch to haul, a wall to break open, a rubbing to take. Look at it and hold E (X on a controller). It's loud the whole time, so one of you works while the others hold the door.
- The stair down to the Gloaming's third level is barred from the far side. Fontaine teaches the quarryman's charge that blows it open, and it stays open for good.
- The rite, retold. It is Fontaine's last quest, The Last Procession: begin it at the altar of the Gloaming Chapel, put him down, then carry his lantern to his tomb under the altar and lay it there. Then a ladder comes down: your way out.
- When the Affliction is three quarters full, a low drone rolls through the catacombs, once.
- Many new recorded sounds: hits and throws, the derringer, falls, the map, the store, rats, spiders and dwellers, the heartbeat, whispers, the mausoleum gate, an oil bottle's rag catching, and the cursed doll's own sound.
- Rope lengths can be salvaged into twine.

### Changes

- Placeholder sounds made in code are gone. A sound that isn't recorded yet is silent for now.
- Every lootable plays the same opening sound for now, until each has its own.
- Being the first to open any lootable pays 25 experience, whatever it is and whatever is inside.
- A recipe you have never made shows as ??? until you make it once.
- The crowbar hits for less: a tool first, a weapon at a pinch. It has its own swing.
- The padded coat now takes three blows before it is torn through.
- What you take down with the free loadout sells for 1 coin each.
- Your stash and the store sort by type to start with.
- Holding on after a bandage or a battery is done no longer starts another: let go first.
